requests.description: NEW BLOODRIDGE CHAMPION, war chief's feared right-hand executioner, more imposing than the reference Warden. Full-body128x128 transparent pixel-art sprite, body120-124px tall, same low top-down three-quarter SOUTHWEST/LEFT view as reference, not a frontal statue. Match approved tiny pixel clusters, dark sepia/ash-brown rotted cloth, corroded bronze and restrained orange lava fissures. Keep ragged burial HOOD, shadowed gaunt ash face with TWO EMBER EYES, bandages, lean long-limbed heroic adult anatomy, small head. Broad shoulder silhouette from heavy torn FUNERARY MANTLE and grave wraps; light battle gear, not bulky muscles or plate suit. SIGNATURE: monumental TWO-HANDED GREAT KHOPESH, heavy squared bronze shield-breaking cleaver with thick spine and forward-hooked end. Blade half the figure's height, broad as his forearm is long. Long sword grip held firmly in BOTH hands across mid-torso, broad blade rises DIAGONALLY beside left shoulder, fully below hood. One oversized ribbed bronze forearm graft anchors grip. Advancing braced stance, left foot forward, torso twisted left; battered asymmetric grave-cloth mantle rises on opposite shoulder. Dominant blade/shoulder mass instantly marks a champion. Weapon is a dominant solid forged blade, thick broad body and angular hooked tip, not a thin sickle, circular C-ring, staff or farming scythe. Clear grip/attachment and gaps around weapon. Upper-left light. Entire figure and weapon fit with2px empty margin, no clipping. No shield, antlers, crown, staff, skull trophies, neon or scenery. Completely new body, costume and stance.

Design a completely NEW elite champion with a much stronger shoulder/weapon silhouette. Do not copy the shield, body, stance or thin curved sword.

owner_direction: Rejected RightHand set. Warden still more powerful; stronger silhouette and proper signature weapon required.
operations: Source PNG bytes saved from MCP image blocks; imported at native pixels with8px margins into144x144 documents, no scaling. Applied approved Warden26-entry palette. Completed option1 clipped weapon cap with6 native Aseprite drawing ops on a separate layer. No other anatomy or shape changes.

visual_review.one: Broad hooked great sword now dominates silhouette; braced two-hand grip and heavier ragged shoulder mass. Source blade clipped at top; native cap completed on separate layer. Best weapon identity in this set. Body head-to-foot slightly shorter than Warden, weapon silhouette extends higher.
visual_review.two: Implanted cleaver visibly continues from forearm, broad sleeve/cape mass, low hooked profile. Overall weapon still narrower than option1.
visual_review.three: Forward broad hook and rear blade, dense shoulder cape mass; rear blade partly foreshortened. Different silhouette from original Skirmisher, owner must assess rank.

status: Option1 selected by Jacob on2026-10-15; approved static design reference. No rotation, motion or integration approval.
validation_note: Three initial requests exceeded undocumented2000-character limit and were rejected before jobs/charges; shortened requests above queued successfully. Shared job-wait returned unrelated jobs; these were not inspected or changed.
